Why does my pipeline warn about Chef@1?

On 2026-10-15, Azure Pipelines shows a retirement error for Chef@1, but the run does not fail. On 2027-03-15, pipelines that still use Chef@1 fail.

Find it in your pipelines

With plain grep, nothing to install:

grep -rniwF 'Chef@1' --include='*.yml' --include='*.yaml' .

How to migrate

Use the "Chef" extension or a script step.

Chef@1 retirement FAQ

Is Chef@1 deprecated?

Yes. Chef@1 is retired on 2026-10-15. Azure Pipelines shows a retirement error, but the run does not fail until removal.

When does Chef@1 stop working?

Chef@1 is removed on 2027-03-15. Pipelines that still use it fail after removal.

What should I use instead of Chef@1?

There is no drop-in replacement task for Chef@1. Use the "Chef" extension or a script step.
